TikTok is a short-form mobile video platform with a global e-commerce business focused on helping users discover and purchase products. The Backend Software Engineer will develop and integrate scalable, secure supply chain and logistics services for TikTok Shop, optimize backend systems, and promote engineering excellence across product development.

Optimize backend systems and services for data security, modularity, computational efficiency and scalability
Deliver best-in-class engineering excellence practices across all product engineering disciplines
